Thursday nights at the Anchor.

Port Calder Jazz is the house night: the same four musicians, a small room, and a bar that knows when not to use the blender.

Pianist Lou Benn usually starts the first set a little after nine. Come earlier if you want a chair.

Thursday nights at the Anchor, weekly, unless the room is booked for something else — and it rarely is.

June 2019 is the usual run. If a Thursday is dark, we will put a note on the door of the Anchor, not always on this page.

Port Calder Jazz is a Thursday night at the Anchor, not a club with a membership list.

The house band has been four musicians for a long time. Lou Benn is at the piano. The others will tell you their names if you buy them a drink.

This site is for the night. It is not a ticket office.
